ActorKind.description: An actor kind: a service, or a human person.

ContentType.description: A lowercase concrete media type `type/subtype` without parameters or wildcards, matched exactly.

CustodianRef.description:
The custodian a reservation names: a subject at the configured token
issuer.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

DocumentAction.description: An action a caller may take on a document, from a closed vocabulary.

DocumentGrantPage.description: One page of document grants, oldest first.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page; absent on the last page.

DocumentLabel.description: One to 256 bytes of text without control characters. Untrusted: stored and returned, never used for authorization.

DocumentPage.description:
One page of the documents a caller holds in custody or reserved, oldest
first.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page; absent on the last page.

DocumentPolicyList.description: The policies the caller may place documents under, by id.

DocumentPolicyView.description:
One policy the caller may place documents under, with the restrictions a
client checks before it uploads.

DocumentStatus.description:
The one status a client reads, derived from the four state dimensions.
There is no `verifying` value: a verification attempt in flight changes
nothing a client can act on.

oneOf.description: Reserved, or the reservation lapsed: no content is stored.
Approved under the current verifier binding and releasable.
Approved once, but not releasable now.
The custodian asked for removal; the bytes await erasure.
The bytes are erased; the record remains.

DocumentVersionView.description:
One document version: its declared and verified content, and the one
status a client acts on.

DocumentView.description: One document as its custodian reads it.

actions.description:
What the reading caller may do to this document now, in vocabulary
order.

label.description: The label the reserving caller chose, as written. Untrusted.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

GranteeRef.description:
The recipient a grant names: a subject at the configured token issuer,
and the actor kind a caller must resolve to for the grant to release
anything to it.

IssueGrantRequest.description:
The body of `POST /v1/documents/{documentId}/grants`: name one recipient
for one exact version.

expiryHours.description:
Hours until the grant expires; the policy default when absent, and at
most the policy maximum. The expiry is fixed at issue.

grantee.description: The one named person the grant releases it to.

versionId.description: The exact document version the grant releases.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

PolicyBinding.description:
The policy a document version was reserved under, frozen at reservation:
its id, its authored version, and the digest of its whole authored body.

ReservationView.description:
The answer to a reservation: the document, its version, and where to
send the content.

uploadExpiresAt.description: When the reservation lapses if no matching content arrived, RFC 3339.

uploadPath.description: The route the content is sent to with `PUT`.

ReserveDocumentRequest.description:
The body of `POST /v1/documents`: reserve one document and the upload of
its single version. Size and media type are refused here, before any
byte moves.

custodian.description: Who holds the document in custody.

expectedDigest.description: The digest the content must have, `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hex.

issuingInstitution.description:
The issuing institution, when the caller repeats it. The institution
recorded is always the caller's access profile's; a different value
is refused.

label.description:
A display label the caller chooses. It is stored and returned as
written and never used for an authorization decision.

length.description: The exact content length in bytes.

mediaType.description:
The media type the content is declared as; the content PUT must send
exactly this `Content-Type`.

policyId.description: The document policy the document is held under.

info.description: Registry Stack Document Store HTTP contract. Every refusal is one application/problem+json document from the closed vocabulary.
info.title: Registry Stack Document Store API
